Regex mode uses ECMAScript Unicode semantics in a cancellable worker with a 5000 ms matching deadline (source default) and an effective 128 MiB old-generation heap. The effective REA_REGEX_MATCHING_DEADLINE_MS value is 5000 ms (source default; default 5000 ms, floor 1 ms, maximum 2147483647 ms). Set REA_REGEX_MATCHING_DEADLINE_MS in the environment that starts REA to a positive decimal integer from 1 to 2147483647, then restart REA. In a running MCP server, use update_analysis_settings with setting regex.matching_deadline_ms and action set instead; the new value applies to new work without a REA restart. The worker old-generation heap does not raise this deadline. A positive Node --max-old-space-size, including NODE_OPTIONS, overrides the 128 MiB worker request. This process has no positive override, so the effective heap is 128 MiB. The effective REA_REGEX_WORKER_HEAP_REQUEST_MIB value is 128 MiB (source default; default 128 MiB, floor 7 MiB, maximum 16384 MiB). Set REA_REGEX_WORKER_HEAP_REQUEST_MIB in the environment that starts REA to a decimal integer from 7 to 16384, then restart REA. In a running MCP server, use update_analysis_settings with setting regex.worker_heap_request_mib and action set instead; the new value applies to new work without a REA restart. A positive Node --max-old-space-size, including NODE_OPTIONS, overrides this request and sets the effective heap. That flag is not limited by this setting's floor or maximum. Raising host memory alone does not raise the request. Matching failure leaves the service available. Literal mode retains native casefold semantics.

capabilities.reason: Set REA_KUNA_COMMAND to the absolute path of a caller-supplied kuna executable (verified with 1.833). REA does not download, install or update Kuna.
limitations: Kuna static analysis: addresses and bytes are its observations, procedure entries and extents its derivations, and pseudocode its reconstruction, never original source.

Kuna's static reference walk unifies forwarding aliases and omits references internal to that alias class. REA keeps only exact-address incoming edges; an empty result does not prove no reference exists.
